kpple01.title: Pluto to Aries: Over It by Friday
kpple01.caption:
Aries tried to speedrun a breakup with a stopwatch, and Pluto crashed through the ceiling about it.
A planet that takes 248 years to lap the Sun says take your time. Who's your friend who's "totally over it" by lunch?

kpple02.title: Pluto to Taurus: The Mug You Kept
kpple02.caption:
Keeping their mug because it's comfy is a very human thing to do.
Letting go isn't losing, it's making room. Keep one kind memory if you like, and let the rest go slowly, at your own pace.

kpple03.title: Pluto to Gemini: Seventeen Drafts of Closure
kpple03.caption:
Draft one was a paragraph. Draft four was a poem. Draft five was a four-minute voice note.
Pluto's verdict: closure is something you give yourself. How many drafts are you on?

kpple04.title: Pluto to Cancer: The Reread at 3 a.m.
kpple04.caption:
3 a.m., scrolled all the way back to their very first hi.
You can honour a memory without living in it. Archive the chat if deleting feels like too much, text a friend, and get some sleep.

kpple05.title: Pluto to Leo: The New Era Launch
kpple05.caption:
Breakup, then a countdown, confetti and era number four.
Pluto got reclassified as a dwarf planet and didn't throw a party. Leo is still negotiating for a small one. Which sign announces their eras?

kpple06.title: Pluto to Virgo: Forty-Six Rows of Blame
kpple06.caption:
A spreadsheet of everything you did wrong is not closure. It's a trial with no end.
You can learn from a breakup without blaming yourself for all of it. Pick one useful lesson, then be kind to you.
